scenes.title: The Silicon Island
scenes.tagline: how one island came to power the modern world
scenes.narration: Every phone, every car, every AI model you have ever used begins in one place.
At four in the morning, the lights in Hsinchu never go out.
Inside these walls, machines carve circuits thinner than a strand of DNA.

scenes.label: of leading-edge chip capacity sits in ==Taiwan==
scenes.narration: Ninety-two percent of the world's most advanced chip capacity sits on this one island.

scenes.title: One island. Every supply chain.
scenes.narration: A single island, a hundred and eighty kilometres off the coast of China.

scenes.headline: Each one is the size of a bus.
scenes.sub: EUV lithography scanners, built in the Netherlands, print the smallest features.
scenes.narration: The machines that print them are the size of a bus, and only one company on earth makes them.

scenes.title: The Weight of It
scenes.narration: Which raises a question nobody likes to ask.

scenes.title: If the island stops, the world stops.
scenes.sub: Cars, phones, data centres — almost nothing modern is built without these chips.
scenes.narration: If the island stops, the world stops. Cars, phones, data centres. Almost nothing modern is built without it.

scenes.title: Forty years in the making
scenes.narration: It took forty years, from a single foundry in nineteen eighty-seven, to the most precise factories ever built.

scenes.headline: The future is printed in silicon.
scenes.narration: The future, it turns out, is printed in silicon.
